description.p: Cadence wraps the real YouTube Music player in a native Qt shell. You keep your account, library and recommendations, and get MPRIS media controls, a tray icon, spring-animated synced lyrics, a mini player and a Plasma widget.

ul.li: Native player bar and a slim custom title bar
Synced lyrics with a karaoke-style sweep and per-song timing nudge
Mini player with lyrics, sleep timer and ListenBrainz scrobbling
Scriptable from the command line and through D-Bus

description.p: Cadence is an independent project and is not affiliated with Google or YouTube.
